extName.description: Extension name (Chrome Web Store, chrome://extensions). Usually not translated.

extDescription.message: Open-source courier label printing: crops A4/A6 label PDFs and prints them on your label or A4 printer in one click.
extDescription.description: Short description in the Chrome Web Store, max 132 characters.

cmdPrintCurrent.message: Print the label from the current tab (active profile)
cmdPrintCurrent.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

paper_A4.message: A4 (210×297 mm) – label in an A6 area to cut out

copySuffix.description: General. Appended to the name of a duplicated profile. Starts with a space.

hostMissing.message: No print helper – printing via system dialog

statusPrinting.message: Processing and sending to the printer…

NO_CONTENT.message: No content found in the PDF (blank pages?).
NO_CONTENT.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errDownloadMissing.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errDownloadFailed.message: Chrome could not download the PDF from this link.
errDownloadFailed.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errHostNeededRead.message: Reading downloaded files requires the print helper (see Settings).
errHostNeededRead.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errTabUnreadable.message: This tab cannot be read (not an http/https/file address). Download the PDF and use “Recently downloaded”.
errTabUnreadable.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errHttp.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages. Keep {status} unchanged.

errUnknownSource.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errNotPdf.message: The file is not a PDF (maybe the page requires you to log in?).
errNotPdf.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errProcessing.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errNoPrinter.message: This profile has no printer selected.
errNoPrinter.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

errPrinter.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages. Keep {error} unchanged.

fallbackNoPrinter.message: This profile has no printer selected – opened the print dialog.
fallbackNoPrinter.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

fallbackNoHost.message: Print helper not installed – opened the system print dialog.
fallbackNoHost.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

notifSentTitle.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

notifSentBody.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages. Keep {name}, {printer}, {labels} unchanged.

notifErrorTitle.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

menuPrint.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages. Keep {name} unchanged.

menuPreview.description: Notifications, context menu and error messages

dropOr.description: Preview and print page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

profileStatus.description: Preview and print page. Keep {name}, {summary} unchanged.

notPdf.message: This is not a PDF file.

sentJob.description: Preview and print page. Keep {job} unchanged.

noHostPrint.message: No print helper – use “Print via system dialog” or install the helper (Settings).

jobExpired.message: This job has expired – choose the file again.

sheetHint.message: The label is printed in an A6 area (105×148 mm) that you simply cut out of the A4 sheet.

position.message: Position of the A6 area on the sheet

posTl.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

posTr.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

posBl.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

posBr.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

unprintable.message: Non-printable edges reported by the driver (applied automatically): left {l}, top {t}, right {r}, bottom {b} mm.

continuousHint.message: This is continuous tape – the driver page is {mw}×{mh} mm. For die-cut labels choose the matching size (e.g. “102 mm x 152 mm”).

paperFromMedia.message: Paper: {w} × {h} mm – taken from the media size above.

paperFromMediaSheet.message: Paper: A4 ({w} × {h} mm) – taken from the media size above. The label goes into an A6 area to cut out.

paperManualHint.message: The size of this media is unknown – set the paper size by hand.

paperCustomHint.message: This paper size is sent to the printer as a custom size.

cropAuto.message: Automatic (skips small text, separates multiple labels)

cropLargest.message: Largest block only (skips e.g. instructions next to the label)

cropSplit.message: Each block separately (several labels on one A4 page)

detectHint.message: White areas wider than the “gap between blocks” split the content into separate blocks. A higher white threshold means lighter greys also count as content.

autoEnabled.message: Automatically print (with the active profile) PDFs downloaded from these domains

autoDomains.message: Domains – one per line, e.g. inpost.pl, dpd.com.pl, baselinker.com

notifications.message: Show notifications when a label is sent to the printer

backupHint.message: Save all profiles and settings to a file and load them on another computer. Printers with a matching name are assigned automatically.

importInvalid.message: This is not a valid settings file.

importMissing.message: Choose a printer for: {list} – not found on this computer.

hostNotInstalled.message: The helper is not installed or not responding.

hostExplain.message: Chrome does not let extensions print to a chosen printer without a dialog. A small helper program sends the finished label straight to the printer. Without it the extension still crops labels, but prints through the system print dialog.
hostExplain.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

hostOutdated.message: Helper v{version} is outdated – install the latest version (v{min} or newer).

helperStepsMac.message:
• Download and open the .pkg file.
  • If macOS says the developer cannot be verified, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
  • Finish the installer, then click Check again.
helperStepsMac.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

helperStepsWin.message:
• Download the .exe file and double-click it.
  • If Windows SmartScreen appears, click More info → Run anyway.
  • When you see “helper is installed”, restart Chrome and click Check again.
helperStepsWin.description: Settings page. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

hostHintNotFound.message: Chrome cannot find the helper registration. Run the helper installer again, then close Chrome completely and reopen it.

hostHintForbidden.message: The helper is installed, but it does not allow this copy of the extension (different extension ID).

hostHintCrashed.message: The helper was found but could not start. Check whether an antivirus blocked it, then run the installer again.

idMismatch.message: This copy of the extension has the ID {id}, but the helper expects {expected}. This happens when the extension is loaded from another package (e.g. the Web Store zip). Load the “extension” folder or extension-unpacked.zip from the release instead – or allow this ID with the command below:

donateHint.message: Donations help pay for code signing, so the helper installs without security warnings.

labels_one.description: General. Number of labels. Plural forms: add the forms your language needs (_one, _few, _many, _other).

labels_other.description: General. Number of labels. Plural forms: add the forms your language needs (_one, _few, _many, _other).

pages_one.description: General. Number of source PDF pages (preview page summary). Plural forms as needed.

pages_other.description: General. Number of source PDF pages (preview page summary). Plural forms as needed.

outPages_one.description: General. Number of printed pages (preview page summary). Plural forms as needed.

outPages_other.description: General. Number of printed pages (preview page summary). Plural forms as needed.

statusSent.description: Toolbar popup. Popup status after printing. {labels} = e.g. "2 labels", {printer} = printer name.

infoSummary.description: Preview and print page. Preview page summary. {labels}, {pages}, {outPages} are already translated phrases; {raster} is the raster mode note or empty. Contains HTML tags – keep them.

rasterMode.description: General. Appended to the preview summary when the label was printed as an image. Starts with a space.

help.description: Settings page. Link to the user guide in the chosen language.

codeSection.description: Settings page. Heading of the section for printing a code or any text as a label.

codeIntro.message: Print a shipping code or any other text as a label, e.g. when you get a code instead of a label.
codeIntro.description: Settings page. Short explanation under the section heading.

codeEnabled.message: Enable code printing (field in the extension popup)

codeContextMenu.message: Show “Print as code” in the right-click menu for selected text

codeSymbol.description: Settings page. Label of the select: QR code, barcode or none.

codeHeader.description: Settings page. Checkbox: print a fixed text above the code.

codeHeaderDefault.description: Default text of the header printed above the code (the user can change it).

codePlaceholder.description: Toolbar popup. Placeholder of the code field.

printCode.description: Toolbar popup. Button next to the code field.

codeEnterHint.description: Toolbar popup. Small hint under the code field.

codeEmpty.description: Error when the code field is empty.

code128Ascii.message: A barcode can only contain Latin letters, digits and basic symbols. Choose a QR code in the settings.
code128Ascii.description: Error when the text cannot be encoded as a Code 128 barcode.

menuPrintCode.description: Right-click menu for selected text. %s is replaced by Chrome with the selected text – keep it.

statusCodeSent.description: Toolbar popup. Status after printing a code. {printer} = printer name.

codeSummary.description: Preview and print page. Summary shown for a code label.

advanced.description: Settings page. Collapsible section at the bottom of a printer profile.

codeShort.message: Code labels: print only as much as the content needs (continuous tape)
codeShort.description: Settings page, advanced profile options. Checkbox.

codeMinLength.description: Settings page, advanced profile options. Number field.

codeShortHint.message: For a long roll of continuous tape. With die-cut labels leave it off – the code fills the whole label. A4 profiles print the code in an A7 area to cut out.
codeShortHint.description: Settings page, advanced profile options. Hint under the checkbox.
